statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed and no live one-way price path is available; verified Saudi escalation keeps reopening uncertainty elevated.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low without live NQ structure, while geopolitical and energy risks keep Stress extreme.
headline: Weekend Saudi escalation sustains extreme Stress while NQ Tail remains low without live price discovery
body: NQ futures are closed, so continuation, pullback depth, failed retracements and session-extreme holding cannot be observed. Reuters reports Houthi claims of attacks on Riyadh targets and an Aramco facility in Yanbu, while Saudi export adaptation through Gulf routes partly offsets Red Sea disruption. Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led despite negative breadth, with Treasury yields around 5% and crude above $100. Shared Finviz context is now older than 90 minutes and is therefore excluded from current supporting evidence. The result is extreme Stress and reopening-gap uncertainty without evidence of a persistent NQ Tail path.
